review_locator: PMCID:PMC4626643, Opposing Roles of Interferon-Gamma on Cells of the Central Nervous System in Autoimmune Neuroinflammation; PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Cytokine-induced expression of vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1) by astrocytes and astrocytoma cell lines
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma as an inducer of astrocyte adhesion-molecule expression; the cited primary demonstrates cytokine-induced VCAM1 mRNA and protein in primary human and rat astrocytes and astrocytoma cells.
limitations_preserved: Astrocyte/astrocytoma VCAM1 induction; preserve the lower IFN-gamma-alone potency relative to cytokine combinations and distinguish VCAM1 gene induction from surface adhesion output. No SCI receiver weighting or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4626643, Opposing Roles of Interferon-Gamma on Cells of the Central Nervous System in Autoimmune Neuroinflammation; PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes
primary_title: Cytokine-induced expression of vascular cell adhesion molecule-1 (VCAM-1) by astrocytes and astrocytoma cell lines
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma as an astrocyte adhesion-molecule stimulus; the cited primary detects cytokine-induced surface VCAM1 on astrocytoma cells and VCAM1 expression in primary human and rat astrocytes, with VCAM1/VLA-4-blockable lymphoblast adhesion in the cellular model.
limitations_preserved: Surface VCAM1 and adhesion output in astrocyte/astrocytoma models; preserve cytokine-combination potency, distinguish surface protein from VCAM1 transcription, and do not infer a direct IFNGR-to-VCAM1 molecular relay or SCI weighting.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC4618768, Control of autoimmune CNS inflammation by astrocytes; PMCID:PMC4626643, Opposing Roles of Interferon-Gamma on Cells of the Central Nervous System in Autoimmune Neuroinflammation
primary_title: AMP-activated protein kinase restricts IFN-gamma signaling
decision_basis: The reviews identify IFN-gamma/STAT1 signaling as a CNS-glial inflammatory transcriptional input; the cited primary shows IFN-gamma-induced CCL2 expression in primary astrocytes and links reduced STAT1 nuclear translocation/DNA binding to reduced CCL2 induction.
limitations_preserved: Primary astrocyte Ccl2 induction with AMPK/STAT1 context; preserve energy-state and cell-type boundaries, distinguish Ccl2 transcription from secreted CCL2 and downstream CCR2 signaling, and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting or terminal-TF output.
